official: 寒川町青少年問題協議会条例の一部改正について
session: 令和8年第1回定例会3月会議
name: 協議会にいじめ対策を加え、委員を18人以内に
summary: 現在の町の青少年問題協議会について、名称や委員の構成などを見直します。いじめ防止に関係する機関や団体の連携を調査・審議し、関係者間の連絡調整を行う役割を加えます。委員の上限は21人から18人に変わります。
changes: 協議会の名称に、いじめ問題への対策と連絡調整を担うことを示す表現を加える
いじめ防止に関係する機関・団体の連携に関する調査・審議と連絡調整を役割に加える
委員の上限を21人から18人に引き下げる
委員の区分を町・関係行政機関の職員、学識経験者、町長が必要と認める者に改める
why: 青少年を取り巻く環境の変化や多様化、青少年問題の複雑化を踏まえ、必要な措置を講じるためと、町は説明しています。

notes: code: copied from the source (28 chars): 「を「寒川町青少年問題・いじめ問題対策連絡協議会」に改める」

en.name: Adds bullying measures to council and limits membership to 18
en.official: Partial Amendment to the Samukawa Town Youth Problems Council Ordinance
en.summary: The town will review the name and membership structure of its current Youth Problems Council. It will add a role for investigating and deliberating on cooperation among organizations involved in preventing bullying, and coordinating among the people involved. The membership cap will change from 21 to 18.
changes: Add wording to the council's name to indicate its role in addressing bullying issues and coordinating among those involved
Add investigating and deliberating on cooperation among organizations involved in preventing bullying, and coordinating among those involved, to the council's duties
Lower the membership cap from 21 to 18
Revise the membership categories to include town and related government agency staff, people with academic expertise, and people the mayor considers necessary
en.why: The town says it is taking necessary measures in light of changes and growing diversity in the environment surrounding young people, and the increasing complexity of youth issues.
